title: Changelog Display
content: Build changelog/release notes component. Version structure: version number, date, list of changes. Change types: Added (green), Changed (blue), Fixed (yellow), Removed (red), Security (purple). Timeline layout: vertical timeline with version markers. Collapsible: expand/collapse older versions. Badges: version type (major, minor, patch). Links: issue/PR references as clickable links. Search: filter changes by keyword. Current version: highlight or pin current version. Markdown: render descriptions from markdown. Notification: new badge on unread changelog entries.

variants.simple: Create formatted changelog or release notes display.
variants.detailed: Build changelog/release notes component. Version structure: version number, date, list of changes. Change types: Added (green), Changed (blue), Fixed (yellow), Removed (red), Security (purple). Timeline layout: vertical timeline with version markers. Collapsible: expand/collapse older versions. Badges: version type (major, minor, patch). Links: issue/PR references as clickable links. Search: filter changes by keyword. Current version: highlight or pin current version. Markdown: render descriptions from markdown. Notification: new badge on unread changelog entries.
variants.advanced: Build changelog/release notes component following keep-a-changelog format. Version structure: semantic version (v1.2.3), release date, grouped changes by type. Change categories: Added (new features, bg-green-100 border-green-500), Changed (modifications, bg-blue-100 border-blue-500), Deprecated (soon to remove, bg-yellow-100 border-yellow-500), Removed (deleted features, bg-red-100 border-red-500), Fixed (bug fixes, bg-orange-100 border-orange-500), Security (vulnerability patches, bg-purple-100 border-purple-500). Layout options: simple list, timeline with version nodes, cards per version. Version badges: "major" (breaking changes), "minor" (new features), "patch" (bug fixes only), "beta", "alpha". Collapsible: older versions collapsed by default, click to expand, or virtual scroll for very long history. References: parse and link #123 to issues, PR #456 to pull requests, @username to contributors. Markdown rendering: descriptions can include markdown for formatting, code snippets. Search/filter: filter changes by keyword, category type, or version range. Pin current: current app version highlighted or pinned to top. "What is new" modal: triggered on update, shows latest version changes, dismiss to mark as read. Compare versions: show diff between two versions. Data structure: array of {version, date, changes: [{type, description, issues}]}. RSS/Atom: optionally generate feed for changelog. Contributor credits: optional list of contributors per version.
